description: MainMobileActivity.java is an Android activity class that manages communication with Wear OS devices, checks if the remote Wear app is installed, and provides functionality to open the app in the Play Store on devices missing the app.

classes.name: MainMobileActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages communication with Wear OS devices, checks for the presence of a specific Wear app, and facilitates opening the app in the Play Store on devices where it is missing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and builds the GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes capability listeners and disconnects the GoogleApiClient when activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reconnects the GoogleApiClient when activity resumes.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Sets up capability listeners and initiates device discovery when GoogleApiClient connects.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of the GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failure to connect the GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on changes in device capabilities (app installed/uninstalled).

methods.name: findWearDevicesWithApp
methods.description: Queries for connected Wear devices that have the specific app installed.

methods.name: findAllWearDevices
methods.description: Retrieves all connected Wear devices regardless of app installation.

methods.name: verifyNodeAndUpdateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI based on the current state of connected devices and app installation status.

methods.name: openPlayStoreOnWearDevicesWithoutApp
methods.description: Opens the Play Store on Wear devices that do not have the app installed.
